rules.statement: A judgment-creditor seizing a decree without notice of an undisclosed mortgage held no superior rights over a subsequent voluntary assignee who obtained possession with notice.
rules.supporting_quote: "The case is analogous to a mortgage of movable property where there has been no pledge of the goods and the mortgagee has neglected to register. No doubt B has personal rights against A in the sense that if A had executed the judgment he would have had a claim to the funds as against A, but this is not a security which under either English or Roman-Dutch law would give him any rights against a sub- sequent assignee who obtained possession without notice."
